title: Registrar Review, Approval & Denial of Leave Requests

steps.title: Portal Authentication
steps.description: College Administrator / Registrar authenticates to CampXSync with authorized R31 staff session

steps.title: Navigate to Lifecycle Review Desk
steps.description: Verify College Lifecycle desk loads with institutional review authority

steps.title: Inspect Pending Leave Requests Queue
steps.description: Desk displays active queue of pending lifecycle and leave requests submitted by students

steps.title: Verify Leave Request Type and Pending Status
steps.description: Verify request type badge indicates LEAVE and status badge confirms PENDING state

steps.title: Open Rejection Remarks Modal
steps.description: Registrar initiates rejection workflow, exposing mandatory regulatory justification dialog

steps.title: Verify Rejection Guardrail Validation
steps.description: Attempting rejection without justification triggers client-side validation guardrail

steps.title: Assert Validation Guardrail Message
steps.description: System enforces minimum 5-character regulatory rejection justification

steps.title: Dismiss Rejection Modal
steps.description: Registrar dismisses rejection dialog to proceed with standard approval decision

steps.title: Approve Student Leave Request
steps.description: Registrar executes formal approval, dispatching POST /api/v1/lifecycle/requests/{id}/decide through API Gateway

steps.title: Verify Approval Success Confirmation
steps.description: System displays green success notification confirming request approval and student status transition

steps.title: PostgreSQL Lifecycle Request Committed Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_requests has committed status APPROVED with registrar decision timestamp
steps.query: SELECT id, student_id, request_type, status, decided_by FROM stu.lifecycle_requests WHERE id = '77777777-0004-0000-0000-000000000001' AND status = 'APPROVED'

steps.title: PostgreSQL Student Status Transition Committed Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_status transitioned student standing from ACTIVE to ON_LEAVE
steps.query: SELECT student_id, status FROM stu.lifecycle_status WHERE student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a6764861f924' AND status = 'ON_LEAVE'

steps.title: Negative RBAC Enforcement Check
steps.description: API Gateway and Lifecycle Service reject unauthorized decision attempts by non-registrar students with HTTP 403
